gaps: P0: no candidates; P3: only Kunike’s 1826 view from Zemun (#4), where Belgrade is a faint line on the horizon; P6 has no close view of the fortress and old town (panoramas are at night, at sunset, or face New Belgrade)
notes: #1: the Münster block probably first appeared in an earlier Cosmographia edition (#2, a cleaner scan of the same block, claims 1545 but its record is marked as wrong), so 1578 is the date of this printing; drop it if a firm first-publication year is required. #3 shows the 1717 battle (marked as event); the title comes from the Dorotheum auction record and Calza died in 1725. P4 alternative: #7, the same city seen from Kalemegdan. #12 (1865 Tour du monde engraving of the fortress from the Danube) is a good black-and-white P4 alternative but only 30 years from the photochrom.
